spec_match.rationale: Sweeps the exact four PredefinedColorSpace enum values from the HTML spec against getContext('2d'), OffscreenCanvas 2d, and new ImageData — the three surfaces the enum applies to — with verdicts read back from getContextAttributes()/ImageData.colorSpace, and distinguishes echoed vs normalised vs threw per Web IDL enum-conversion semantics.

interactive.rationale: Auto-run sweep with re-run button, a free-text 'offer any string' probe against the real getContext call, and a rejected-value-vs-ignored-member demonstration; all drive real API calls on fresh surfaces and update live outputs.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The feature index card promises all four values offered to the three surfaces with honest TypeError-based detection; the page delivers exactly that.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers unknown-enum TypeError, accepted-but-normalised, partial support (a build where srgb-linear rides an older guard while display-p3-linear does not exist — observed for real on Chromium 141 with experimental features), missing OffscreenCanvas, and the ignore-as-support trap.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5122501071994880, the spec's srgb-linear enum-value anchor, and Web IDL enum conversion.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite asserts accept-and-echo for both new values on context, ImageData and OffscreenCanvas, the pre-existing srgb/display-p3 baseline, real getImageData conversion, and a negative unknown-enum-throws contract; verified 3 pass / 5 fail / 0 blocked on Chromium 141, matching real support.

runtime_evidence.rationale: chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this environment; verified per the routine toolset with headless Chromium 141 via Bash + CDP: sweep verdicts srgb=echoed, display-p3=echoed, both linear values=threw across all three surfaces; custom probe returned the exact TypeError for rec2100-linear and accepted display-p3; reject-vs-ignore showed TypeError vs silently-ignored misspelt member; desktop 1280 and emulated 360×740 DPR3 screenshots; zero page exceptions (the only console error is the sandbox proxy resetting fonts.googleapis.com, environment-wide).

telemetry_health.rationale: demo-telemetry.js loaded defer; asserts on sweep (with per-value verdicts), custom offers, reject-vs-ignore, and a failure branch if the sweep itself throws.

design_system.rationale: All colours via CSS variables; verdict colours (emerald/rose/amber on paper/stone) meet AA at the sizes used; buttons keep the global bg+color pair; tables scroll inside .scroller; 44px minimum control heights.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons/inputs with explicit labels, table caption + th scope on both axes, verdicts as text (not colour-only), aria-live polite outputs for sweep summary and probe results, Enter submits the custom probe; no canvas-only state on this page.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP-emulated 360×740 DPR3 touch and 1280 desktop both verified: documentElement scrollWidth equals innerWidth (no horizontal overflow — wide tables scroll in their own container), controls stack via auto-fit grid, tap targets ≥44px.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify the all-pass path on a real Chrome 155 binary
openQuestions.detail: On Chromium 141, the full six-echoed result is unreachable even behind flags (display-p3-linear is absent from the binary; srgb-linear activates via the older CanvasHDR-era guard under --enable-experimental-web-platform-features, which was verified). Once a 155 Canary/stable is available in the verification environment, confirm the sweep reports all-echoed and the conformance suite goes 8/8.

openQuestions.title: Add a worker-scope OffscreenCanvas sweep
openQuestions.detail: The OffscreenCanvas column runs on the main thread. PredefinedColorSpace also applies inside workers (OffscreenCanvas + ImageData are worker-exposed); a small additive concept could post the same sweep to a worker and compare, catching any main-vs-worker enum skew.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible canvas demo with text alternatives and live region readouts
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic tables with caption/th scope, native controls with explicit labels, and never encode state in colour alone.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Verdict matrix is a real table with caption and row/column headers; verdicts are literal words styled with colour on top; outputs are aria-live=polite.

guidanceConsulted.query: wide gamut and HDR canvas color management
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep layouts responsive with intrinsic sizing and let wide content scroll in its own container rather than the page.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: auto-fit minmax grids for controls, .scroller overflow-x container around the matrix, overflow-wrap:anywhere on long flag/error tokens; verified no page-level horizontal overflow at 360px.

summary: The canonical probe concept: every enum value against every surface, three-way verdicts that cannot mistake normalisation or ignored members for support, and the TypeError detection path made explicit. Honest on Chromium 141 (both linear values throw everywhere) and verified to flip correctly when srgb-linear is unlocked behind the experimental flag.
